verdict.rationale: Twilio's first-party Phone Numbers API docs state that developers can search for and buy available numbers and manage their numbers. The APIs can be called over HTTPS or through language SDKs, and regulatory bundle APIs support compliance during provisioning. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of configuration details (e.g., setting voice/SMS webhook URLs on a number, which 'manage' only implies), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the provisioning workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search, buy, and configure phone numbers through a documented API

citations.quote: With the Phone Numbers APIs, you can search for and buy available Twilio phone numbers, manage your Twilio numbers
You can use the APIs directly over HTTPS or through Twilio SDKs available for several programming languages.
shows how to create a Regulatory Bundle with the v2 Regulatory Compliance (RC) REST APIs.
